about: Arkhangelsk International Airport named after F. A. Abramov (Talagi). Operator: JSC Arkhangelsk Airport. The first flight on the new runway near the village of Talagi was received on 5 February 1963.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Bus No. 12 runs to Morskoy-Rechnoy Vokzal via Gagarina St, Voskresenskaya St and Troitsky Ave. Bus No. 153 runs to Severodvinsk, to Truda Ave: from the airport at 5:50, 9:10, 14:20 and 17:30. Check the timetable with the carrier.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Domestic business lounge on Level 2 of Pavilion No. 3. Entry 2,928 ₽, children 2–12 years 1,464 ₽, under 2 free. Free for business class and Aeroflot Bonus Gold and Platinum holders. Mileonair, Every.Lounge, Golden Key and other cards give access to SKY LOUNGE on Level 1 of Pavilion No. 3 after security, 04:00–21:30, up to 2 hours.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage in Pavilion No. 3, open round the clock. An item up to 30 kg and shorter than 1 m costs 250 ₽ per day. Documents, money, valuables and perishable food are not accepted.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: Short-stay P2: 30 minutes free, then 150 ₽ per hour, over 4 hours 800 ₽ per day. Long-stay P1: 400 ₽ per day from the first minute. Free P4 with 70 spaces 200 m from the terminal, no time limit. Lost parking ticket: 2,000 ₽.
